investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

english.notes:
(i)The offence of trespass is not complete until there is a refusal to quit at the request of any officer or agent of the company. A clear request must be made to the person to leave, followed by either a specific refusal or a failure to depart within a reasonable time. Discretion should be used as a simple ejection may be all that is needed.
(ii) This offence can occur anywhere on railway property. There is no need to prove that notices are displayed in such a case.
(iii) It is for the justices to determine whether the trespass is wilful; see Jones v Taylor (1858) 1 EandE 20.
(iv) The maximum fine is fixed at level three in relation to railways covered by the following statutes-
Channel Tunnel Act 1987 section 43; Midland Metro Act 1989 section 50; Leeds Super tram Act 1993 section 63.

other.powersofarrest:
In England and Wales: Arrest without warrant.

In Scotland: Common Law powers apply.
other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding level one on the standard scale or one month imprisonment in default of payment. (Level three or one month imprisonment in default of payment in relation to railways covered by the following: section 43 of the Channel Tunnel Act 1987; section 50 of the Midland Metro Act 1989 and section 63 of the Leeds Super tram Act 1993).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
